audit_scope.task_scope: cell-state mapping and development-only RNA-ATAC integration

scglue_local.corpus: No upstream checkpoint or pretraining corpus; only declared outer-training donor modality matrices and training-only guidance graph

interpretation: Locally trained scGLUE avoids checkpoint-corpus contamination when every feature, representation, graph, balancing weight, parameter, and head is fitted only on outer-training donors. Its largest hazards are false obs-name pairing, full-data HVG/LSI or guidance-graph construction, label-supervised encoders, donor batch categories, untrusted dill deserialization, and treating the experimental cross-decoder as a validated profile model. The current task registry correctly retains scGLUE as latent-only.
remaining_blockers: Activate GSE296875 only after donor/barcode/well/reference/peak/QC and same-nucleus joins pass; validate PairedSCGLUE obs-name masks on fixed fixtures.
Prove GSE244832 uses distinct unpaired RNA and ATAC row identifiers and cannot enter PairedSCGLUE cross-prediction losses.
Freeze outer-training-only HVGs, RNA/ATAC representations, exact gene-peak graph vertices/edges/weights/signs, batches, balancing weights, dimensions, early stopping, heads, and five seeds.
Build a state-dict-only local serialization adapter with exact architecture, feature, graph, and preprocessing manifests; never load external dill.
Keep decode_data nonpromotable until a separate TaskSpec freezes target library size, target batch, output distribution, no-held-ATAC fixture, and assay-native baselines.
Validate GLUE v0.4.1 source on a frozen modern environment with L40S import, sparse data path, forward/backward, resume, determinism, numeric tolerance, and memory probes.
For sealed RNA cell-state mapping, prohibit feature refitting, cell-type supervision, query optimization, or calibration on GSE289173.
sealed_champion_eligibility: cell-state eligible in principle after local data_runtime_serialization_and_leakage fixtures; RNA-conditioned ATAC is currently latent-only and cannot champion
